integrity: The analytic statement is proved in RESULT.md with reproducible exact-rational consistency checks in check_two_caps.py. Finite computations are not presented as infinite proof. scientific_limitations: Only real homogeneous quadratic spherical harmonics on the two-sphere, two congruent non-overlapping spherical caps and full-sphere-normalized surface measure.
